name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: Conflict review now shows full document and revision IDs plus field-by-field Version A and Version B differences
Sensitive values are redacted in the conflict diff, and unavailable revision bodies are called out explicitly
Dashboard labels purchase challans as GRN and uses the matched party name for receipt vouchers
Conflict manifest and backup export remain read-only; no automatic resolution or production writes
No tax, invoice numbering, or existing business data was changed in this update
